Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.Abi → Prop := fun abi => (List.map Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.SampleSlot.key abi.sample).Nodup ∧ (List.map Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.OutputSlot.key abi.outputs).Nodup ∧ abi.libraries.Nodup ∧ (∀ slot ∈ abi.sample, Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.targetPrefix.isPrefixOf slot.key = Bool.false) ∧ (∀ slot ∈ abi.sample, slot.type = Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.SlotType.noun → slot.max = Option.none) ∧ ∀ door ∈ abi.door, Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.DoorShape abi door

Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest → ℕ → Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.Program → Prop := fun domain cellId program => cellId = Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.physicalId domain (Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.programId program)

∀ (rest : List UInt8), Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.abiCodec.decode (Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.abiFrameV1 ++ rest) = Option.none ∧ Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.abiCodec.decode (Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.abiFrameV2 ++ rest) = Option.none ∧ Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.abiCodec.decode (Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.abiFrameV3 ++ rest) = Option.none ∧ Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.abiCodec.decode (Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.abiFrameV4 ++ rest) = Option.none

∀ {program : Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.Program}, Minidregg.Theory.Noun.canonical program.jam = Bool.true → ∀ {n : Minidregg.Theory.Noun}, Minidregg.Theory.Noun.cue program.jam = Option.some n → program.jam = n.jam

∀ {left right : Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.Program}, Minidregg.Theory.Noun.canonical left.jam = Bool.true → Minidregg.Theory.Noun.canonical right.jam = Bool.true → Minidregg.Theory.Noun.cue left.jam = Minidregg.Theory.Noun.cue right.jam → left.jam = right.jam

∀ {bytes : List UInt8} {state : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Store Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.layout}, Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.decode bytes = Option.some state → Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.encode state = bytes
{α : Type} → List UInt8 → Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.StreamCodec α → List UInt8 → Option α

∀ {α : Type} {frame : List UInt8} {stream : Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.StreamCodec α} {bytes : List UInt8} {value : α}, Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.framedDecode frame stream bytes = Option.some value → frame ++ stream.encode value = bytes

∀ {α : Type} (frame : List UInt8) (stream : Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.StreamCodec α) (value : α), Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.framedDecode frame stream (frame ++ stream.encode value) = Option.some value

∀ {α : Type} {frame old : List UInt8} (stream : Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.StreamCodec α) (rest : List UInt8), frame.length ≤ old.length → List.take frame.length old ≠ frame → Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.framedDecode frame stream (old ++ rest) = Option.none

∀ (jam : List UInt8), Minidregg.Theory.Noun.canonical jam = Bool.true → Minidregg.Theory.Noun.cue (jam ++ [0]) = Minidregg.Theory.Noun.cue jam → Minidregg.Theory.Noun.canonical (jam ++ [0]) = Bool.false

∀ {bytes : List UInt8} {program : Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.Program}, Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.programCodec.decode bytes = Option.some program → Minidregg.Compiler.NockProgramCodec.programCodec.encode program = bytes
